component: OAuth telemetry location and preference tracking

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The landing adds OAuth browser preferences to tracked boolean telemetry, missing flatpak/snap labels, and a string where authentication extra. The original authorization branch sets external before starting its loopback listener, or internal for its fallback, so the extra records selected path rather than proof a window opened. recordTelemetry still requires issuer and reason and clears reason after recording. Existing tests add internal expectations; new reset-and-check cases assert external with exact event extras. Later three-mode values and the stale two-value description are linked existing facts. The shared helper per-event deepEqual lacks a message. No auth flow or telemetry was run.
title: The initial OAuth where extra records request selection and extends exact event expectations
